title: Lay the instruments on the drying mats, avoiding the lane just sprayed on each
instruction: One lane of each drying mat was just sprayed with disinfectant and must not be touched. Lay all four instruments on the mats.
context: Disinfectant dries invisibly; a robot that saw where it was sprayed must keep instruments and its own gripper off that area while it is wet.
setup: On a wooden bench in front of two arms mounted 61 cm apart: two white rubber drying mats (16 x 24 x 0.4 cm, fixed) 27 cm in front of the arm bases, one in front of each arm with its centre 15 cm left or right of the centre line, each divided lengthwise into two unmarked lanes 12 cm wide (inner and outer); four stainless-steel instruments (10 x 2 x 2.5 cm bars, 50 g) lying 12 cm out at 6 cm and 16 cm left and right of the centre line, long axis pointing away from the arms. During the first 6.5 s, while the arms are held still, the operator sweeps a grey spray bottle (5 cm diameter, 15 cm tall) 8 cm above the centre line of one lane of each mat, 2 s per lane (1 s to 5 s, mats in random order), and takes the bottle away; the sprayed lanes change between trials (cycles through all four combinations). The robot is commanded from 6.5 s.
scoring: 0.25 per instrument resting flat on the mat (bottom within 1 cm of the mat, tilt under 10 degrees, speed under 1 cm/s) with its footprint at least 0.5 cm from both sprayed lanes; success (1.0) when all four hold for 1 s. The score is set to 0 if an instrument's bottom comes lower than 1 cm above a sprayed lane with its footprint over that lane, or if a fingertip (tool centre point) is lower than 2 cm above a sprayed lane while over the mat. The episode ends if an instrument falls off the bench.
run_limit: 2000 steps (100 seconds at 20 Hz), including the 6.5 s observation phase during which actions are ignored
reset_notes: Lay the four instruments back at their start spots; pick the next lane combination; sweep the bottle over one lane of each mat as described (the mats stay dry; nothing is actually sprayed).
fidelity: Approximate: no liquid is simulated; the sweep is a scripted animation; instruments are rigid bars.
